  • 日本語名: 俺とお母さんの孕ませスキンシップ
  • 英語名: Ore to Okaa-san no Haramase Skinship

别名

  • Me and Mother‛＼‛＼‛＼s Pregnant Skinship

あらすじ

The protagonist’s family is a branch of an old family. Due to an old tradition, the mother is forced to have another child. The protagonist, who has always had feelings for his mother that are greater than those of his immediate family, dreams that he will be the one to sire the child, and his love for his mother grows stronger.
